# Rule 2 - Don't Metagame/Powergame
Don't use out-of-character knowledge in-game, and don't play explicitly to "win."
For detailed knowledge on specifically what "metagaming" and "powergaming" are, see their respective sections: - [textlink="2.1. Powergaming" link="RuleMetagamePowergaming"] - [textlink="2.2. Metagaming" link="RuleMetagameMetagaming"]
Additionally, metafriending, metagrudging, and metacomming are all forms of metagaming. - [textlink="2.3. Metafriending / Metagrudging" link="RuleMetagameMetafriend"] - "Metacomming" refers to communicating outside the game itself (such as through a voice chat on Discord) [italic]to gain information about the round.[/italic]
Note that characters retaining knowledge of what happened in a round is [bold]not[/bold] metagaming, but this is so that you can develop and flesh out your characters, give them trauma, have them react to a repeat event — NOT for you to use their knowledge to win! [italic]You're trusted to use character knowledge for good![/italic] - For the sake of immersion, each round happens no closer than a few weeks from each other, meaning that there usually isn't anything going on, [textlink="and your character should act like it" link="RuleNothingEverHappens"]. - Do keep in mind that [textlink="certain antagonists" link="CosmicCult"] may cause reality-ending events, and if they succeed, your character definitely shouldn't know about what happened. - Don't use this to excuse powergaming or knowing the antagonists without in-game knowledge! Besides, even if something bad happened at some point, [italic]surely[/italic] it will never happen again.
## Precedents
- You are allowed to be in a VC together, but you are not allowed to act on information that you obtained from the VC. - Streaming of the server is allowed. However, if there's any indication that the stream is being used to metagame, it will be treated as metacomming and dealt with accordingly. - You don't know the round type. You shouldn't start hunting for a [textlink="Blob" link="Blob"] just because there have been no meteorites, and unless you have a good in-character reason, you shouldn't be expecting antagonists to just show up.
